parsed.rationale: All four `SequentialMockSession` type-alias declarations reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and are nested inside test-suite outer types (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests`). Although the pipeline emitted `is_test: false` on every record — likely because a bare type-alias node was not attributed as a test declaration — the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/`) and the enclosing class names (all suffixed `Tests`) make the test-fixture nature unambiguous. Lifting these aliases into shared production code would couple production targets to test-only session-mocking semantics. The correct resolution, if the duplication is genuinely unwanted, is to consolidate within the test file itself (e.g., hoist a single `SequentialMockSession` typealias to file scope inside the test file), not to extract to a shared package.
